summary: Reads a 4-byte header word into a local buffer via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch (0x00566C00), extracts a 10-bit operation id from bits 8-17, and validates the header: bits 29-31 must equal 0x20000000 and bits 17-22 must be zero. A valid header dispatches NetworkOperationDispatchByFlag (0x00566DF0) with the operation id plus 1; an invalid header dispatches it with the raw operation id. Returns the dispatch result on both paths. Called from ModelSceneFileLoader (0x004B6C90).

local_names.v2: local header buffer; only v2[0] (the header dword) is read

operations.description: Read 4 bytes into the local buffer v2 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch (0x00566C00), filling v2[0] with the header dword.
Header validity test: take the valid branch when (v2[0] & 0xE0000000) == 0x20000000 AND (v2[0] & 0xFC0000) == 0; otherwise take the invalid branch.
Extract the 10-bit operation id from the header: op = (v2[0] >> 8) & 0x3FF.
Invalid-header path: call NetworkOperationDispatchByFlag(op) (0x00566DF0) with the raw operation id.
Return the NetworkOperationDispatchByFlag result from the invalid-header path.
Valid-header path: call NetworkOperationDispatchByFlag(op + 1) (0x00566DF0) with the operation id incremented.
Return the NetworkOperationDispatchByFlag result from the valid-header path.
